prompts.prompt: Where is the customer experience leaking across channels?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: 417,454 contacts; 10,586 open more than 48 hours. The highest share open too long is Email (10%). Public data not yet loaded.

prompts.prompt: How much comes back after Cora, as a call or a complaint?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: Cora took 113,422 contacts and resolved 107,129; 5,503 are still open. Calls: 188,142. The 7-day return to a call or complaint needs Cora logs joined to call records inside the bank.

prompts.prompt: How many complaints could go to the Financial Ombudsman Service?
prompts.answer: As at 2026-11-12: 299 complaints are within 10 days of the final-response deadline, 384 are past it with no final response, 2,613 are unhappy with the final response, and 1,177 have been referred. Rules: 8 weeks; payment services 15 business days (35 in exceptional cases). Eligibility and risk only; LisN does not predict who will refer.

prompts.prompt: Which journey is leaking most customers this week?
prompts.answer: Everyday banking: 1,295 of the 1,308 switching-intent contacts in the last 7 days followed a contact at that stage. Next: Open (5) and Service requests (4); 0 had no earlier contact in the window. Internal, illustrative.

prompts.prompt: What is the Consumer Duty evidence for financially vulnerable customers?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: 101,284 contacts from customers flagged financially vulnerable; 5,614 open, 8 with no reply after 48 hours. Consumer Duty outcomes: Products and services · price and value · consumer understanding · consumer support.
